<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="IEUCJ6CBqFHTVZJpmTTM"> <mxGraphModel dx="2060" dy="1124" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
title Multi-Agent Workflow

skinparam backgroundColor white
skinparam componentStyle rectangle
skinparam shadowing false
skinparam defaultFontName Arial

rectangle \"User Query\" as input

rectangle \"Orchestrator\n(LangGraph)\" as orchestrator

rectangle \"Task Planner /\nDecomposer\" as planner

rectangle \"RAG Retrieval\" as rag

database \"Qdrant\" as qdrant
database \"Neo4j\" as neo4j

rectangle \"Verification Agents\" as verification {
 rectangle \"Fact Verification\nAgent\" as fact
 rectangle \"Citation Verification\nAgent\" as citation
 rectangle \"Logic / Contradiction\nAgent\" as logic
}

rectangle \"Reliability /\nEvaluator Agent\" as evaluator

rectangle \"Self-Repair /\nRefinement Agent\" as repair

rectangle \"Response Generator\" as generator

rectangle \"Final Response\" as output

input --> orchestrator
orchestrator --> planner
planner --> rag

rag --> qdrant
rag --> neo4j

rag --> fact
rag --> citation
rag --> logic

fact --> evaluator
citation --> evaluator
logic --> evaluator

evaluator --> generator : Reliable
evaluator --> repair : Unreliable

repair --> orchestrator : Re-plan

generator --> output

@enduml",
 "config": null
